programs.title: I Was Prey: Feeding Frenzy
programs.desc: Andrea Schlake volunteers at an animal sanctuary when a chimpanzee escapes its enclosure and chases her down  a great white shark knocks surfer Todd Endris off his board and attacks him.

programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Bosco the Croc's Big Move
programs.desc: Robert takes on the challenging task of relocating Bosco, the most aggressive croc at the zoo  Bindi must investigate Forest the giraffe's bad knee problem  Terri helps Harley the koala find love at the end of a difficult breeding season.

programs.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Cat Men to the Rescue
programs.desc: After a team effort to rescue Bear the cat, Shaun goes solo on a night mission to find the cat, Spaz, that has been missing for three weeks  a call about a feral cat in a woman's backyard leads to danger.

programs.title: Carter's W.A.R.: At All Costs
programs.desc: Ivan goes on a journey to save his friend's 19 rhinos from the poaching epidemic now sweeping through South Africa. The solution: a logistical nightmare of transporting the entire herd to a secure location 600 miles across the country.

programs.title: Monster Mako
programs.desc: Little is known about the large mako sharks that live in the Gulf of Mexico, the fastest and most elusive shark species.

programs.title: The Zoo: The Kings of Queens
programs.desc: A trio of new penguin chicks are introduced to the pool for their first swim  family dynamics change when the mandrill monkey troop welcomes a new baby  a pair of king vultures are prepped for their big debut at the Queens Zoo.
